title: NEW EVENT: HORTUS DE ESCAPISMO OPEN
lines: 01 NEW EVENT: HORTUS DE ESCAPISMO OPEN
EVENT DURATION: December 21, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 11, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Hortus de Escapismo event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
- Phase 1: Sanctilaminium Ambrosii
DURATION: December 21, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Phase 2: Sacrarium Derelictum
DURATION: December 28, 2023, 16:00 (UTC-7) - January 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Secretae Continere]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Secretae Continere] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARD: [★★★★★: Insider], Ambulacrum Ambrosii Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Holy Statue Fragments, etc.
[Convivia Cenarum Localia]
DURATION: December 21, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 11, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Holy Statue Fragments by clearing event stages and completing [Secretae Continere] missions. Holy Statue Fragments can be used to redeem items from [Convivia Cenarum Localia].
REWARD: Insider's token, Ambulacrum Ambrosii Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
-During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – ARBITER AEQUISSIMUS
DURATION: December 21, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Arbiter Aequissimus], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting
★★★★★★: Executor the Ex Foedere
★★★★★: Spuria / Cantabile

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATOR NOW AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game
★★★★★★: Executor the Ex Foedere
★★★★★: Spuria
★★★★★: Insider
Note:
- Operator Insider is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Hortus de Escapismo, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
- Executor the Ex Foedere and Spuria will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after January 4, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Executor the Ex Foedere, Spuria, and Insider will gain more trust in the event stages during December 21, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
04 [0011 TEMPEST] & [TEST COLLECTION] NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 21, 2023, 10:00 - January 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- 0011/Tempest Series - Hear the Wind Sing for Fartooth
- 0011/Tempest Series - The Fruition for Shalem
- 0011/Tempest Series - The Road to Here for Paprika
The following Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store for a limited time, including:
- Test Collection - There They Be for Saga
05 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 21, 2023, 10:00 - January 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- Epoque Collection - Weißer Sand for Beeswax
- Epoque Collection - Londinium Style Miko for Tsukinogi
- Epoque Collection - Leisurely Afternoon for Perfumer
06 NEW FURNITURE SET AMBULACRUM AMBROSII
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, Ambulacrum Ambrosii will be available.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Hortus de Escapismo event rewards and redeem in Convivia Cenarum Localia (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
- Duration: December 21, 2023, 10:00 - January 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
07 CHIP PACK AVAILABLE FOR A LIMTIED TIME
DURATION: December 21, 2023, 10:00 - January 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
EXECUTOR CHIP PACKAGE
CONTENTS: Guard Dualchip * 4, Guard Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
Please stay tuned for more information!
